title: Add AI-assisted policy evaluation backend to Expense Agent
summary: Expense Agent now supports AI-assisted policy evaluation, storing immutable evaluation results for each policy and expense report subject, with new tables, pages, and APIs to track compliance status and enable policy validation at approval.
key_points: Added Expense Policy Evaluation table to record immutable results including policy snapshot, compliance verdict, and timestamp
Expense report lines now expose policy status (No Policies, Not Evaluated, Needs Recheck, Flagged, or Cleared) with lazy currency tracking
New APIs for expense policies, policy evaluations, and policies awaiting evaluation with atomic completion and stale-buffer protection
API renames: expensePolicyFlag to expensePolicyEvaluation, expensePolicyFlags to expensePolicyEvaluations, and similar for posted records
UI improvements showing policy status on expense lines with green for compliant and yellow for non-compliant results
quote: Expense Agent needs a backend contract for AI-assisted policy evaluation that records both compliant and non-compliant results.
